name: Charivna kazka
source:
"In distant, heavenly kingdoms, there lived a moon princess and a sun prince. Their love was difficult because they could see each other only for a brief moment. But they had a promise: one day they would be together forever! Although years and centuries passed, they never forgot about that promise and sincerely believed in it, because it was hope that kept their love alive!"

The curtains fell and the entire audience began to applaud. Two people left the theater: Lorem, a bright, somewhat lively girl, and Dejan, a calm, thoughtful boy. Despite the fun and enjoyable time they spend together, there is one problem in their relationship - they can't figure out their own feelings... or rather, they don't talk about them at all. And even when they're ready to take the first step, unexpected characters intervene in their lives...

[translated from [url=https://plyih.itch.io/acharmingfairytale]itch.io[/url]]
